_comment: Export inventory for the OLAP team: what we handed over, and enough
metadata to prove they received exactly that. Generated by the export, never
edited by hand. One entry per exported file.
Done when every file in the export appears here with a checksum that
verifies, and schema_commit points at the commit whose migrations produced
the schema the data was read from.
Must NOT contain: credentials, connection strings, internal hostnames, or
any data — this is metadata about the export, not part of it.
Remove this key when the export starts writing the file.
